# R4C synthetic IFC fixture

`r4c-synthetic-box.ifc` was authored specifically for this repository. It contains one
four-metre by 0.2-metre wall extruded to three metres, a complete project/site/building/
storey hierarchy, and one deterministic property set.

third-party model data or geometry is included.
